#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

task_0() {
  local name="item-0"
  local count=0
  if [ "$count" -gt 5 ]; then
    echo "processing $name with count $count"
    for j in $(seq 1 $count); do
      case "$j" in
        1) echo "first" ;;
        2|3) echo "early" ;;
        *) echo "other: $j" ;;
      esac
    done
  elif [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "empty $name"
  else
    while read -r line; do
      echo "$line" | tr 'a-z' 'A-Z'
    done < <(printf '%s\n' "line-$name")
  fi
  return 0
}

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

task_0() {
  local name="item-0"
  local count=0
  if [ "$count" -gt 5 ]; then
    echo "processing $name with count $count"
    for j in $(seq 1 $count); do
      case "$j" in
        1) echo "first" ;;
        2|3) echo "early" ;;
        *) echo "other: $j" ;;
      esac
    done
  elif [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "empty $name"
  else
    while read -r line; do
      echo "$line" | tr 'a-z' 'A-Z'
    done < <(printf '%s\n' "line-$name")
  fi
  return 0

  local count=9
  if [ "$count" -gt 5 ]; then
    echo "processing $name with count $count"
    for j in $(seq 1 $count); do
      case "$j" in
        1) echo "first" ;;
        2|3) echo "early" ;;
        *) echo "other: $j" ;;
      esac
    done
  elif [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "empty $name"
  else
    while read -r line; do
      echo "$line" | tr 'a-z' 'A-Z'
    done < <(printf '%s\n' "line-$name")
  fi
  return 0
}

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

task_0() {
  local name="item-0"
  local count=0
  if [ "$count" -gt 5 ]; then
    echo "processing $name with count $count"
    for j in $(seq 1 $count); do
      case "$j" in
        1) echo "first" ;;
        2|3) echo "early" ;;
        *) echo "other: $j" ;;
      esac
    done
  elif [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "empty $name"
  else
    while read -r line; do
      echo "$line" | tr 'a-z' 'A-Z'
    done < <(printf '%s\n' "line-$name")
  fi
  return 0
}
